description.zh: 志愿者流浪猫领养小站的几何剪纸风官网：首页（剪纸猫主图、等家的猫、三步领养流程、临时家庭/捐物资/志愿者、回家故事）和一只猫的领养申请页（档案、申请表、提交后流程）
description.en: Paper-cut site for a volunteer cat adoption group: home page with a paper-cut hero, cats waiting for homes, adoption steps and ways to help, plus one cat's profile with an application form
